spec.goal: Surface the cross-scope state in the vv panel: an addendum-pending operational state (any non-terminal ADD-NNN in impact-addendum.xml blocks execution, attention styling, routes to vv-execute) and an impact fan-out suffix on the state chip (consumer-scopes from spec impact). Read impact-addendum.xml through the workspaceFiles bridge; extend STATE_SKILL, locale (en/ru), and the fallback state list.
spec.architecture: CLASSIFY_BOUNDARY: domain-only. Change confined to dsh-vv-panel/client.js (web-client plugin). State derivation stays file-based and honest (no fabricated state): addendum-pending is derived from the actual impact-addendum.xml ADD statuses; fan-out from the spec impact consumer-scopes. stale-approval still takes precedence. The host bridge is read-only.

C-PANEL.name: Panel cross-scope state
C-PANEL.responsibility: addendum-pending state + impact fan-out chip + attention styling + locale + fallback state list; read impact-addendum.xml via workspaceFiles

testing.strategy: node --check client.js; activation.test.mjs passes; helper logic verified (hasPendingAddendum recorded→true/resolved→false; readImpactFanout extracts consumer-scopes). addendum-pending overrides execution states; stale-approval precedence preserved.
testing.coverage: addendum-pending derivation; fan-out chip; attention styling; locale en/ru; fallback list; no fabricated state.
